data.title: bn-24d: M1.8 demo and managed block
data.description: High-risk review of exact-pinned local demo supervision, qualified Teapot and Investigation authority, initial manifest retention, generated lead-plan-verify walkthrough, and managed guide preservation. Failure-mode questions: Can untrusted workspace state redirect privileged processes or binaries? Can startup failure publish partial authority or misstate commit/effects? Can a supervisor or child escape lifecycle/expiry/stop guarantees? Can evidence/manifest/run identity be confused or substituted? Can generated help/README examples bypass the frozen contracts or act on unintended targets?

data.body: [medium] Preserve the exact checked workspace inode through publication. check_demo_root validates and owner-checks root_dir, but returns only the state lock. prepare then spends a long interval staging Investigation, Teapot, sessions, a manifest, and child processes before init_demo calls init_with_manifest(root, ...), which canonicalizes and opens the pathname again. An attacker able to rename an entry in a shared parent can swap it for a symlink to another operator-owned directory during that interval, redirecting scourge.toml, .scourge, and AGENTS.md writes and publishing runtime authority for an unintended root. Carry the checked root descriptor/identity into init_demo and perform publication relative to that descriptor (or otherwise make identity continuity race-free), and add rename/symlink substitution tests at the publication boundary.

[medium] Do not report demo-stopped when no supervisor was contacted. UnixStream::connect returning NotFound or ConnectionRefused is converted to Ok, and the caller unconditionally emits success. If the control socket is deleted, replaced, or lost while the supervisor or an escaped child is still alive, the command falsely confirms shutdown and the privileged engine/fixture may continue until expiry with no usable stop route. Return an unconfirmed/unknown failure unless an authenticated supervisor acknowledges shutdown, or independently bind and verify the owned process identity and exit. Cover a live supervisor with a missing/refused socket.

[medium] Keep an idempotent recovery route for every startup publication boundary. This gate rejects any existing .scourge directory or scourge.toml, while init_demo can create coordination/pending state before a later error and start can publish a bound workspace before supervisor.keep fails. Both cases make the next demo invocation refuse the same path, so a committed-but-dead runtime or partial initialization cannot be resumed, reconciled, or safely torn down. Reuse the private pending/binding identity to distinguish an owned retry from a collision, resume or clean the exact prior setup, and test failures before/after coordination creation, config publication, and supervisor acknowledgement.

[low] Migrate an untouched prior Scourge-managed block instead of classifying it as a user edit. This change updates the managed body digest from 45bad5e7dc7b43ff6ecba5e66792d3ba2e5522ece706d8d83e5b29d061cb72ab to 406ff54eb55289c6560384611ae3518f0e9c6ff95586cb755b6569c67133cd29, but has_unchanged_block accepts only the exact current block; a correctly hashed prior installed block therefore reaches this comparison and returns Edited. Upgrades/retries strand stale owned instructions and require unsafe manual surgery. Recognize an explicit allowlist of prior owned digests and atomically replace only when the prior body hashes to its recorded known digest; continue rejecting unknown or actually edited blocks. Add a prior-version migration test that preserves surrounding user bytes and metadata.

[risk:high review summary] (1) Binary/process substitution: Teapot and Investigation are digest-pinned, copied privately, and run with cleared environments, but the validated workspace inode is not carried through publication (th-f30n4i). (2) Partial publication/commit/effects: manifest retention precedes authority publication and committed failures identify a bound workspace, but there is no idempotent recovery after partial coordination or committed supervisor failure (th-bx6bc3). (3) Lifecycle: separate process groups, Teapot PDEATHSIG, an eight-hour expiry, and acknowledged normal stop are present; absent/refused control sockets nevertheless produce false stop success (th-1a5yvm). (4) Identity: capture begin is checked against the retained external run/producer/Investigation identity, and the manifest artifact/digest/runtime binding is rechecked; no additional evidence/run substitution was found in this range. (5) Generated actions/docs: live verify next is emitted only for a complete bound plan without preview overrides, README/help target the explicit demo workspace, and future commands remain labelled; prior valid managed blocks cannot migrate (th-h2ba6l). Focused offline tests passed: demo_process 2 passed/2 qualified-live ignored, documentation_process 2 passed, workspace core 4 passed, current guide retry and passive generated-help tests passed. The exact qualified Teapot binary was unavailable here, so the two ignored live demo/README tests were not executed. BLOCK pending the four threads.

data.reason: BLOCK: workspace identity can be substituted between validation and publication; demo startup has no safe retry/recovery after partial or committed failure; stop falsely succeeds without supervisor acknowledgement; and prior valid managed-guide blocks cannot migrate.

data.body: Fixed in 697779d: DemoWorkspace retains checked root/state directory descriptors and serialized dev/inode identity through publication; config, coordination, guide, and binding writes are descriptor-relative, and selection rechecks the bound inode. workspace::demo::tests::rename_and_symlink_substitution_never_receive_publication and final_binding_rejects_a_same_path_replacement_inode pass. Full offline just check and the exact four-test demo-check pass.

Fixed in 697779d: a durable private intent/lease/binding makes retry and exact cleanup idempotent across intent, coordination staging/rename/flush, config flush/publish, binding flush/publish, and lost supervisor ACK. Exact lease acquisition distinguishes confirmed-dead retirement from a live-unreachable supervisor; retirement preserves binding, runtime/evidence, config, and coordination reads, while a held live lease remains committed/unconfirmed. interrupted_intent_and_pre_activation_receipts_are_idempotent, each_publication_boundary_is_recoverable, confirmed_dead_runtime_retires_without_losing_workspace_reads, and live_unreachable_runtime_stays_committed_and_unconfirmed pass; exact demo-check passes.

Fixed in 697779d: control requests and replies are authenticated over action+nonce+stage with the private token; Stop succeeds only after a verified stopped ACK sent after engine/fixture shutdown. Missing and refused/non-socket control paths return unconfirmed failure. supervisor::tests::control_authentication_binds_token_nonce_action_and_stage and stop_never_succeeds_for_missing_or_refused_socket pass; the exact lifecycle demo-check also passes.

Fixed in 697779d: migration recognizes only the explicit prior digest 45bad5e7dc7b43ff6ecba5e66792d3ba2e5522ece706d8d83e5b29d061cb72ab, verifies the actual prior body hash, and atomically replaces only that owned block. Edited/unknown blocks still refuse; surrounding arbitrary user bytes and mode/uid/gid/access-ACL metadata are preserved. prior_untouched_block_migrates_preserving_user_bytes_and_metadata, edited_or_unknown_blocks_refuse_migration, and concurrent_append_retries_without_losing_user_content pass.

All four blocking findings are fixed in 697779d. Focused results: workspace demo recovery/identity 7 passed; managed-guide migration 3 passed; supervisor authentication/stop 2 passed. Full CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true just check passed (log /tmp/bn-24d-just-check-final.log, sha256 130a71cb52330dd2c602405bd816520d908b0e67ac70cd97d01e334df72731d9). Exact just demo-check /tmp/bn-1or-teapot /tmp/scourge-investigation-11TUBF/investigation passed 4/4 (log /tmp/bn-24d-demo-check.log, sha256 5f83602cada1d91b0904d342c54232e002325d2bca9821428b63a6e2d89c3fad). No retarget or review re-request was performed.

[resolved at 861a076] The checked lexical root and state are retained as descriptors plus serialized device/inode identity in crates/scourge-core/src/workspace/demo.rs:200-249. Publication is descriptor-relative and rechecks path identity before and after coordination, guide, config, and binding writes at lines 576-683; ordinary selection also rejects a same-path replacement via the binding directory identity at crates/scourge-core/src/workspace.rs:944-952. The rename/symlink and replacement-inode tests passed from the exact-HEAD test binary.

[resolved at 861a076] crates/scourge-core/src/workspace/managed_guide.rs:315-359 now accepts only the explicit prior digest after hashing the actual prior body, while unknown or edited blocks still fail closed. The replacement path preserves mode, owner, group, and access ACL at lines 202-247 and revalidates inode plus snapshot before rename at lines 143-199. Migration, edited-block refusal, concurrent append, and metadata tests passed from the exact-HEAD binary. The documented final rename window and non-ACL xattr residuals remain accepted.

[resolved at 861a076] crates/scourge-core/src/workspace/demo.rs:400-517 now persists intent, lease, coordination, binding, retirement, and append-only abandoned-runtime receipts with retry-safe atomic saves. Receipted precommit runtimes are never recursively deleted: reset first proves the exact unlocked lease, discards only the exact receipted coordination inode, durably records attempt plus home and lease identities, then rotates to a fresh attempt. Unreceipted runtime and coordination names are preserved and never adopted. crates/scourge-core/src/workspace/coordination.rs:95-215 binds publication to a random durable name/inode and exact database seed. The 16 focused recovery tests plus the isolated SIGKILL orphan-helper test passed. Disk growth and the 1 MiB abandoned-vector ceiling remain explicit follow-up bn-1x2t; no actual power-loss simulation was performed.

[resolved at 861a076] crates/scourge/src/demo/supervisor.rs:294-367 authenticates request and reply over token, nonce, action, and reply stage; accepted nonces are lifetime-replay protected. Stop returns success only after engine teardown and fixture join, when the supervisor emits the authenticated stopped proof at lines 220-230. Missing, refused, malformed, EOF, truncated, and oversized clients cannot produce success or poison the listener. All four focused supervisor tests passed outside the sandbox after the sandbox itself rejected UnixListener bind with EPERM.

[risk:high re-review at 861a076] (1) Binary/process substitution: executable selection is canonicalized outside the workspace, admitted by exact bytes/digest, copied into the private mode-0700 runtime, and Teapot is re-qualified immediately before exec; Investigation invokes a private snapshot of the checked bytes. The workspace cannot redirect privileged executable authority. (2) Partial publication/commit/effects: one claim lock serializes init and demo, every authority boundary has a durable intent or receipt, confirm_active fsyncs the binding file and state directory before Committed, and failures return not_committed or unknown according to that durable check. Receipted and unreceipted abandoned runtimes are retained rather than unsafely cleaned or adopted. (3) Lifecycle/expiry/stop: the supervisor holds the exact private lease, owns fixture and engine process groups, enforces the eight-hour bound, keeps config/state continuity after activation, rejects malformed clients, and acknowledges Stop only after teardown with authenticated nonce/action/stage proof and replay protection. (4) Evidence/run identity: capture begin is cross-checked against the retained external run, producer, handle, Investigation identity, artifact bytes and digest; coordination retry verifies the exact workspace, engagement, manifest artifact and pass seed. The control token, session cookies, project state, and evidence stay below private runtime/state directories and are not projected in CLI responses. (5) Generated actions/docs: demo returns structured lead and stop argv bound to the normalized workspace; live verify next appears only for a complete unblocked plan without preview overrides; passive help examples, README syntax, and the exact native lead-plan-verify-stop walkthrough are covered. Independent exact-HEAD focused results: recovery 16 passed, isolated SIGKILL helper 1 passed, guide 3 passed, supervisor 4 passed, docs 2 passed. Retained exact native demo evidence reports 5 passed and the retained full offline check is green. Accepted residuals remain: final AGENTS.md rename/non-ACL xattrs, append-only retained-runtime disk growth and 1 MiB vector limit tracked by bn-1x2t, shell-surrogate SIGKILL coverage rather than a native orphan, and no actual power-loss simulation. These residuals do not undermine current fail-closed authority or recovery acceptance. No new blocker found.
